heavy metal toxicity is one of the major environmental concerns and it is a serious threat to the environment, human health and the economy.
heavy metal contamination is one of the most serious environmental problems in the world.
heavy metals, occurrence and their toxicity for plants are reviewed.

the uptake, translocation and distribution of heavy metals in plants, and their impact on the environment.
the impact of heavy metals on plants and the mechanisms by which plants tolerate heavy metal stress.
the effects of heavy metals on plants and the mechanisms of tolerance to heavy metal toxicity.

the effects of heavy metals on plants are complex and varied and depend on the metal, the plant and the environment.

the effects of heavy metals in plants are highly variable, and the response of plants to heavy metals depends on the type of heavy metal, the plant species, plant growth conditions and the concentration of the metal.
the effects of metals on plant growth and physiology are highly variable, depending on the metal, the concentration and duration of exposure.

heavy metals are toxic to plant growth and development.
the toxicity of heavy metals to plants is a complex process and the mechanism is not fully understood.

plants have evolved a number of mechanisms to cope with metal toxicity.
